dedupe_keys.name: data on the dynamics of land cover at different scales kef siliana region and sub spatial units of agroecological living lab landscape in tunisia 2017 2022

description: MELDATA, hosted by the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas, provides CSV tables describing land-cover dynamics in the Kef-Siliana region of north-west Tunisia. The tables aggregate 2017 to 2022 land-cover changes at regional scale and for subunits of an agroecological living-lab landscape. The provider says that a QGIS classification workflow produced the changes and that UNCCD guidance was used to assess associated landscape degradation or improvement. The named public page and API list two data tables and three dictionary CSV files under CC BY-SA 4.0, with no price shown. For simulation, regional planners could use the tables to bound land-change or agricultural adaptation scenarios, keeping the classification method and spatial aggregation explicit. The tables do not contain asset-level water or transport networks, and no newer time period is claimed. File values were not downloaded or independently checked. This is related to the catalogue AGRIDATA Tunisia portal, but it is a specific regional research release. Its separate companion MELDATA deposit provides a 10 m transition raster.
